rationale: stable_hindcast_ensemble has the lowest historical hindcast SMAPE (30.61), ahead of regime_damped_harmonic (33.82), robust_shape_analog (35.90), and robust_seasonal_level (38.58). No fold-level dispersion or median-error results are provided to falsify the ensemble’s stability assumption. The verified September reports conflict on the observed state and both concern events ended before the forecast horizon, so they neither establish a persistent breakpoint, slope, or harmonic supporting regime_damped_harmonic nor justify a quantitative adjustment. The May and July reports likewise lack normalized analog distances and subsequent increments, so they do not validate robust_shape_analog. The historical leader therefore remains the provisional choice.
